title: Likeness Notes: An AI-Realized Concept Album as a Field Experiment in Declared Intent, Cybernetic Workflows, and Methodology
description: Likeness Notes is a methodological monograph and production dossier documenting the creation of Likeness, an independent concept album realized through multimodal generative AI (Google Gemini 3 and Lyria 3). Operating within the traditions of practice-as-research and critical making, it provides an unredacted audit of human intent, prompt workflows, audio post-production, and EU AI Act compliance.
